questions.q: 9. In an election between two candidates, the defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost the election by 2545800 votes. If 365500 votes were declared invalid and 30% people did not cast their vote, what was the approximate number of people (in millions) in the electorate who did NOT cast their votes ?
questions.s:
9.(a)
Let the total valid votes be V.
The defeated candidate received 42% of the valid votes and lost by 2545800 votes.
Therefore, the winning candidate received = 100% - 42% = 58% of the valid votes
The difference in votes between the two candidates = 58% - 42% = 16% of the valid votes.
V × 16% = 2545800
V = 15,911,250
Total votes polled = 15,911,250 + 365500 = 16,276,750
30% of people did not cast their votes so 70% did cast their vote.
70% = 16,276,750
(people who did not cast their votes) 30% = 6,975,750
So, approximate number of people in the electorate who did not cast their votes is 7 million

Solution

Price = 100 : 119
Exp = 100 : 112

SSC GD 2021 22/11/2021 ( Afternoon)
questions_hin.s_hi:
5.(b)

मान लीजिए, संख्या 18 यानि (2,9) का LCM है।सही संख्या = 18 × 92 = 81 गलत संख्या= 18 × 29 = 4आवश्यक प्रतिशत  = 81-481 × 100 = 7781 × 100 = 95.06≈  95%

questions_hin.q_hi: 8. एक संख्या का 25% दूसरी संख्या के 30% से 7 अधिक है। संख्याओं के बीच का अंतर 29 है। संख्याएँ क्या हैं?
questions_hin.s_hi:
8.(c) माना दोनों संख्याएं x और y हैं,

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

25% of x - 7 = 30% of y

⇒(25100 × x ) - 7 = 30100 × y⇒14x - 7 = 310y⇒14x - 310y = 7⇒10x - 12y = 280 .......(1)

तथा, x - y = 29 -----(2)

समीकरण (1) और (2) को हल करने पर,

हम प्राप्त करते हैं, X= 34 और Y= 5
